name: daiku
description: Autonomous architecture-first development method: skill contracts, role orchestration, and project parameter contracts.

interface.shortDescription: The autonomous development method, as contracts in prose
interface.longDescription: Twenty-two contracts describing what to do and in which order: problem study, decision document, execution brief, execution, multi-round review cycle, memory and documentation alignment, merge reconciliation, commit, release. Who runs each step and on which model is declared by a single orchestration contract; the guest project's values live outside the skills, in two parameter files.
defaultPrompt: Study this problem and write its document
Deliver the feature from the already-decided folder
Review the diff and close the review with the commit
